# Third-party components

- Three.js r170: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r170 — MIT; license included.
- GSAP 3.12.5 and ScrollTrigger 3.12.5: https://gsap.com/ — copyright and licensing reference retained in each distributed file header. Review https://gsap.com/standard-license/ for the applicable terms.
- DM Sans and Manrope: https://fonts.google.com/ — SIL Open Font License; notices included.
- Original OmniSecuritas logo: recovered from the user-referenced company's archived website, used for this requested company website redesign.

All runtime JavaScript, fonts, and brand assets are served locally by the site.

- React and React DOM: MIT licenses included.
- Motion: MIT license included.
- Tailwind CSS: MIT license included.
- The generated `js/homepage-islands.js.LEGAL.txt` preserves bundled notices.

- Lucide React: ISC license included; bundled SVG icons.
- tw-animate-css: MIT license included; component animation utilities.

- COBE: MIT license included; used by the current hero globe. The previously shipped Three.js asset is retained but not loaded by the homepage.
